title: Sonya AI
tagline: Sonya - The Empathetic AI Agent built on ElisaOS designed to bring emotional intelligence, psychological depth, and thoughtful engagement to users
description: Sonya is an innovative project that merges the power of ERC-712 tokens with AI-driven psychological support. By staking tokens, users earn rewards that can be redeemed for one-on-one sessions with an advanced AI psychologist, inspired by Eliza. This AI agent, equipped with both text and voice interaction, retains context from past conversations, offering a more personalized and continuous mental health experience.
how_its_made:
On-Chain (Base Network)
	•	Marketplace: Enables users to purchase usdSONYA using USDC and USDT.
	•	Scheduler: Facilitates secure session storage for 1-on-1 AI therapy sessions after payment in usdSONYA or rSONYA.
	•	Staking: Allows users to stake SONYA tokens and earn rSONYA, which can be redeemed for AI therapy sessions.
	•	rSONYA: A staking reward token (EIP-712 standard) distributed to SONYA stakers.

Backend
	•	Secure AI Interaction: Connects to the ElizaOS AI Agent’s REST API after JWT-based user authentication.
	•	Multimodal Communication: Supports text-to-text and speech-to-speech interactions via OpenAI’s APIs.

Frontend
	•	Seamless Access: Privy integration for user authentication.
	•	Scheduling Panel: Allows users to book 1-on-1 AI therapy sessions.
	•	AI Chat: Supports real-time audio and text-based conversations.
	•	Staking Dashboard: Provides full control over SONYA staking and rewards management.

AI Agent
	•	ElizaOS AI Agent with multi-platform capabilities:
	•	Twitter, Discord, Telegram integrations.
	•	REST API support for broader ecosystem interoperability.
